fn:canonical.cost: O(k) work; the smaller of the k-mer and its reverse complement, compared as unsigned values.
fn:canonical.failure: DnaError/BadK (k outside 1..32, or kmer outside the 2k-bit range), offset is 0.

fn:decode.cost: O(k) work; returns the k bases of the packed k-mer as uppercase text.
fn:decode.failure: DnaError/BadK (k outside 1..32, or kmer outside the 2k-bit range), offset is 0.

fn:encode.cost: O(bases) work; input must be 1..32 uppercase A, C, G, T.
fn:encode.failure: DnaError/BadLength (empty or longer than 32 bases, offset 0), BadBase (symbol other than A, C, G, T, offset is the base index).

fn:gcCount.cost: O(bases) work; counts C and G.
fn:gcCount.failure: DnaError/BadLength (sequence over 1 MiB), BadBase (symbol other than A, C, G, T, offset is the base index).

fn:hammingDistance.cost: O(bases) work; number of positions where the two sequences differ.
fn:hammingDistance.failure: DnaError/BadLength (lengths differ, or a sequence over 1 MiB, offset 0), BadBase (symbol other than A, C, G, T, offset is the base index in a).

fn:kmers.cost: O(bases * k) work when canonicalForm is true, O(bases) otherwise; returns at most 1M k-mers in sequence order.
fn:kmers.failure: DnaError/BadK (k outside 1..32), BadLength (sequence over 1 MiB), BadBase (symbol other than A, C, G, T, offset is the base index).

fn:reverseComplement.cost: O(k) work; complement of each base, in reversed order.
fn:reverseComplement.failure: DnaError/BadK (k outside 1..32, or kmer outside the 2k-bit range), offset is 0.

fn:roll.cost: O(1) work; drops the oldest base and appends base (0..3 for A, C, G, T).
fn:roll.failure: DnaError/BadK (k outside 1..32, or kmer outside the 2k-bit range), BadBase (base outside 0..3), offset is 0.
